system.name: DreamDojo
system.one_liner: A foundation robot world model pretrained on 44k hours of egocentric human video with latent actions, post-trained on robots and distilled to real time.

content.variant_note: four numbered framed panels in a jigsaw: pretraining, robot post-training, distillation, applications; no arrows between panels
content.argues: Pretraining on large human video with latent actions, then post-training and distillation on robots, yields a real-time world model usable for teleoperation, policy evaluation and planning.
content.subject: Human-video pretraining, robot post-training, autoregressive distillation and four application tiles, shown with real frames and robot photos.

lessons.what_to_learn: One accent hue on the model boxes and arrows over grey frames and full-colour photo tiles keeps a dense, photographic overview readable; numbered corner tabs order a jigsaw of panels with no inter-panel arrows.
lessons.suits: Large-scale data-plus-model papers (robotics, video, world models) whose overview must show many real frames, several embodiments and several applications.

evidence: DreamDojo acquires comprehensive physical knowledge from large-scale human datasets by utilizing latent actions as unified labels.
After post-training and distillation on the target robots, our model can predict the future world in real time
It also enables live teleoperation and online model-based planning.

summary: DreamDojo is a generalist robot world model: pretrained on 44k hours of egocentric human video with latent actions as unified action labels, post-trained on target robots and distilled into a real-time student that supports live teleoperation, policy evaluation and planning. Figure 1 is a four-panel overview laid out like a jigsaw with grey numbered tabs 1 to 4. Panel 1 shows three 3x3 mosaics of human-video thumbnails (In-lab, EgoDex, DreamDojo-HV) funnelled by a translucent green wedge into the green DreamDojo box, with noisy and clean frame tiles going in and out. Panel 2 shows four robot photo cutouts (GR-1, G1, AgiBot, YAM). Panel 3 shows the DreamDojo Student on strips of frames, and panel 4 shows four photo tiles of applications. Green is the only saturated colour.
summary_zh: DreamDojo 是经人类视频预训练、机器人后训练和蒸馏得到的实时通用机器人世界模型。图 1 用四个带编号的灰框面板依次展示人类视频预训练、机器人后训练、自回归蒸馏，以及遥操作、策略评估、规划等应用，实拍帧为主，绿色标出模型。
